caseName: Woodkraft Division, Georgia Kraft Co. v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Woodkraft Division, Georgia Kraft Co. v. National Labor Relations Board

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. [Certio-rari granted, 464 U. S. 981.] Upon consideration of the motion of the Solicitor General and the response filed thereto, that portion of the judgment of the Court of Appeals on which certiorari was granted is vacated, and the case is remanded to the Court of Appeals with directions that the case be remanded to the National Labor Relations Board for further consideration in light of Clear Pine Mouldings, Inc., 268 N. L. R. B. 1044 (1984).
